That old spreadsheet is not an active current core build input.
additional_context: FHIR-38789 later split the ambiguous dependency/profile-compatibility behavior into structuredefinition-imposeProfile for validation-imposing semantics and structuredefinition-compliesWithProfile for consistency assertions; FHIR-38789 is already represented on the combined branch. The current Extension Pack source contains imposeProfile and a retired structuredefinition-dependencies definition that points to imposeProfile. FHIR-49727 later changed the imposeProfile title, and the current Extension Pack source reflects that accepted title.
